summary: Static keyword co-occurrence in minified SDK bundle; no traced installer harm
details: Package is an SDK bundle (@magda/semantic-indexer-sdk) shipped as a single minified dist/index.js. Static keyword matches fired on POST verb occurrences and the substring 'dyndns' within the minified file, but the matches are only keyword co-occurrence in a large bundled artifact with no traced code path showing installer-side data being read and sent to an attacker-controlled destination. No lifecycle install/postinstall hooks execute the pattern, no environment scraping, credential-path reads, or hardcoded non-first-party exfil endpoints were identified. The POST occurrences are consistent with normal HTTP client usage inside an SDK.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
